description: Future versions of known families are priced with the newest known version of the family (opus 6 -> Opus 5.5, sonnet 7.2 -> Sonnet 5.5, haiku 6 -> Haiku 5.5, fable 9.9 -> Fable 5.1) and get their own row. A Claude id of an unknown family (claude-nova-1-0) has no known price: counted in calls and tokens at cost 0, with its own row. <synthetic> and other vendors' models are not counted (uncountedCalls).
